name: ddi-inform
description: DDI inForm ERP (Infragistics on WinForms, UniVerse backend on port 31438). Tabbed workspace in the main window: Customer Master, Product Master, A/P Invoice, Purchase Order, ... Written after the first real run (2026-11-18).
note: The data lives on a UniVerse server (ProgramData\DDISYSTEM\Inform\installedapplication.config names it). Tables and rules need a read-only UniVerse ODBC login from the vendor, a nightly export drop folder, or UVSQL logging on the server.
